title: Make NGM Medium
author: Cancer Research UK / Wellcome Trust Gurdon Institute media kitchen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5szg6f6
materials: Stir until all solutes are dissolved.

steps.title: Prepare NGM Base Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the NGM medium base by combining water and salts in a large vessel.

substeps.instruction: Measure approximately 4.8L of double distilled H2O in a 5L bell jar with a magnetic flea.
Add 15g of NaCl and 12.5g of bacto peptone to the water.

steps.title: Dispense Medium and Agar
steps.instruction: Divide the medium and add agar into individual bottles based on the desired volume.

substeps.instruction: For 1L bottles: Dispense approximately 972ml of NGM media and 17g of agar, then add a magnetic flea.
For 500ml bottles: Dispense 486ml of NGM media and 8.5g of agar, then add a magnetic flea.

steps.title: Sterilize Medium
steps.instruction: Label, date, and autoclave the bottles.
